name: Basic pension insurance (养老保险)
authority: Social Insurance Law arts.10–12; HRSS employer-rate guidance: employer 16%, employee 8% (https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tdjjf_17554/20250120/t0035_1430072.html). Shanghai social-insurance base 7,460–37,302 (2025 notice, from 1 July 2025: https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgsgg_17341/20250918/t0035_1435637.html). The base is the declared prior-year monthly average wage (a new hire’s first full month) clamped to the bounds; a worker drawing a pension is outside it. Rounded to the fen per side: the instruments read here state no other rounding (the Kunming 2026 employer notice’s own examples are to the fen).

rules.refusal: Record the social-insurance contribution base on the pension registration (`contribution_base`): the prior year’s monthly average wage, or a new hire’s first full month. It controls every insured amount and has no default.

elections.label: Social-insurance contribution base (monthly)
elections.description: The prior calendar year’s monthly average wage at this employer, or a new hire’s first full month’s wage, before the published floor and ceiling. Every social-insurance scheme of this version reads it.

name: Employee medical insurance incl. maternity (医疗保险)

Shanghai social-insurance base 7,460–37,302 (2025 notice, from 1 July 2025: https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgsgg_17341/20250918/t0035_1435637.html). The long-term-care pilot (沪府办规〔2025〕19号) is funded by transfer from the medical fund: no separate payroll line (register CN-SH37). Rounded to the fen per side: the instruments read here state no other rounding (the Kunming 2026 employer notice’s own examples are to the fen).

rules.refusal: Record the social-insurance contribution base on the pension registration (`contribution_base`): the prior year’s monthly average wage, or a new hire’s first full month. It controls every insured amount and has no default.

name: Housing provident fund (住房公积金)
authority: Shanghai housing fund 2,690–37,302, equal 5–7% each side, supplementary 1–5% each side if elected; 沪公积金管委会〔2025〕8号 from 1 July 2025 (https://www.shzfgjj.cn/html/newxxgk/zcwj/gfxwj/228051.html) and the official 2025 Q&A (https://www.shzfgjj.cn/html/newxxgk/zcjd/228183.html). A foreign or permanent-resident worker joins only by mutual agreement; a pensioned retiree does not contribute (沪公积金管委会〔2023〕3号 arts.5, 21). elections.description: The prior calendar year’s monthly average wage, or the first-ever / transferred worker’s qualifying month, before the published bounds.

name: Individual income tax on wages (工资薪金个人所得税)
authority: IIT Law art.3 and art.6(1); STA 2018 No.61 art.6 with annex table 1 (residents: cumulative withholding at this employer — the year’s income less the year’s employee social insurance and housing fund, CNY5,000 a month employed here and the declared special additional deductions, on the annual table, less tax already withheld; a negative balance is not refunded) and art.9 with table 3 (non-residents: the month’s wage less CNY5,000 on the monthly table). https://www.chinatax.gov.cn/n810219/n810744/n3752930/n3752974/c3963396/content.html STA 2020 No.13: a resident whose first wage income of the year is paid mid-year deducts CNY5,000 for every month from January (election `first_wage_income_this_year`). STA 2020 No.19: the qualifying continuing employee deducts CNY60,000 from January (election `annual_60000_from_january`) https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100012/c5194953/content.html. 国发〔2018〕41号 and 2023 No.14: the housing-rent deduction is at most CNY1,500 a month in a municipality or provincial capital and cannot be claimed with housing-loan interest; major-illness medical expense is annual-only and is never withheld monthly. Housing-fund employee shares are relieved in full: the seeded rates (Shanghai 5–7%, Kunming 5–12%) and base ceilings sit inside the 12% / 3× city-average exemption of 财税〔2006〕10号 — an assumption the register (CN-N43) has not closed for Kunming. Tax is kept to the fen.

rules.refusal: Record tax residence as resident or non-resident on the employment terms: the IIT Law art.1 withholding method depends on it and no default exists.
Housing rent and housing-loan interest cannot both be deducted in one year (国发〔2018〕41号).

elections.label: First wage income of the year (STA 2020 No.13)
elections.description: The resident declared no wage income earlier this year: CNY5,000 is deducted for every month from January.

elections.label: CNY60,000 deducted from January (STA 2020 No.19)
elections.description: Qualifying continuing employee: declared by this employer every month of the prior year with that year’s wages at most CNY60,000.

name: IIT on an annual one-off bonus taxed separately (全年一次性奖金)
authority: MOF/STA 2023 No.30 (to 31 December 2027): a resident may have a qualifying annual one-off bonus taxed apart from the year’s wages: the bonus ÷ 12 selects the rate and quick deduction of the monthly comprehensive-income table, and the tax is bonus × rate − quick deduction. Once per person per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号). https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5211524/content.html. A bonus the employee does not elect to separate is an ordinary bonus class counted in IIT. Non-resident bonus treatment (MOF/STA 2019 No.35) is not transcribed and refuses.

rules.refusal: A separately taxed annual bonus is a resident election (MOF/STA 2023 No.30); the non-resident bonus rule (MOF/STA 2019 No.35) is not transcribed.
The separate annual-bonus method may be used once per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号); pay a second bonus as an ordinary bonus.

name: IIT on a lump sum on ending the labour relationship (解除劳动关系一次性补偿收入)
authority: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(1) (from 1 Jan 2019, http://szs.mof.gov.cn/zhengcefabu/201812/t20181227_3110164.htm): a lump sum a resident receives on ending the labour relationship (economic compensation, living subsidy and similar) is exempt up to three times the local prior-year average annual wage; the excess is not added to the year’s comprehensive income and is taxed alone on the annual comprehensive-income table (STA 2018 No.61 annex). The average is the exit fact lcl47_average_monthly_wage × 12, or unrecorded the version’s default for it; the same series and year as LCL art.47 (owner rule 2026-09-28, register CN-N39 / CN-SH50). A non-resident’s termination pay is not transcribed and refuses.

rules.refusal: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(1) is read for a resident; a non-resident’s termination pay is not transcribed.

elections.description: Qualifying continuing employee: declared by this employer every month of the prior year with that year’s wages at most CNY60,000.

name: IIT on an annual one-off bonus taxed separately (全年一次性奖金)
authority: MOF/STA 2023 No.30 (to 31 December 2027): a resident may have a qualifying annual one-off bonus taxed apart from the year’s wages: the bonus ÷ 12 selects the rate and quick deduction of the monthly comprehensive-income table, and the tax is bonus × rate − quick deduction. Once per person per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号). https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5211524/content.html. A bonus the employee does not elect to separate is an ordinary bonus class counted in IIT. rules.refusal: A separately taxed annual bonus is a resident election (MOF/STA 2023 No.30); the non-resident bonus rule (MOF/STA 2019 No.35) is not transcribed.
The separate annual-bonus method may be used once per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号); pay a second bonus as an ordinary bonus.

name: IIT on a lump sum on ending the labour relationship (解除劳动关系一次性补偿收入)
authority: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(1) (from 1 Jan 2019, http://szs.mof.gov.cn/zhengcefabu/201812/t20181227_3110164.htm): a lump sum a resident receives on ending the labour relationship (economic compensation, living subsidy and similar) is exempt up to three times the local prior-year average annual wage; the excess is not added to the year’s comprehensive income and is taxed alone on the annual comprehensive-income table (STA 2018 No.61 annex). rules.refusal: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(1) is read for a resident; a non-resident’s termination pay is not transcribed.

authority: IIT Law art.3 and art.6(1); STA 2018 No.61 art.6 with annex table 1 (residents: cumulative withholding at this employer — the year’s income less the year’s employee social insurance and housing fund, CNY5,000 a month employed here and the declared special additional deductions, on the annual table, less tax already withheld; a negative balance is not refunded) and art.9 with table 3 (non-residents: the month’s wage less CNY5,000 on the monthly table). https://www.chinatax.gov.cn/n810219/n810744/n3752930/n3752974/c3963396/content.html STA 2020 No.13: a resident whose first wage income of the year is paid mid-year deducts CNY5,000 for every month from January (election `first_wage_income_this_year`). name: Individual income tax on wages (工资薪金个人所得税)
authority: IIT Law art.3 and art.6(1); STA 2018 No.61 art.6 with annex table 1 (residents: cumulative withholding at this employer — the year’s income less the year’s employee social insurance and housing fund, CNY5,000 a month employed here and the declared special additional deductions, on the annual table, less tax already withheld; a negative balance is not refunded) and art.9 with table 3 (non-residents: the month’s wage less CNY5,000 on the monthly table). https://www.chinatax.gov.cn/n810219/n810744/n3752930/n3752974/c3963396/content.html STA 2020 No.13: a resident whose first wage income of the year is paid mid-year deducts CNY5,000 for every month from January (election `first_wage_income_this_year`). STA 2020 No.19: the qualifying continuing employee deducts CNY60,000 from January (election `annual_60000_from_january`) https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100012/c5194953/content.html. 国发〔2018〕41号 and 2023 No.14: the housing-rent deduction is at most CNY1,500 a month in a municipality or provincial capital and cannot be claimed with housing-loan interest; major-illness medical expense is annual-only and is never withheld monthly. Housing-fund employee shares are relieved in full: the seeded rates (Shanghai 5–7%, Kunming 5–12%) and base ceilings sit inside the 12% / 3× city-average exemption of 财税〔2006〕10号 — an assumption the register (CN-N43) has not closed for Kunming. Tax is kept to the fen.

rules.refusal: Record tax residence as resident or non-resident on the employment terms: the IIT Law art.1 withholding method depends on it and no default exists.
Housing rent and housing-loan interest cannot both be deducted in one year (国发〔2018〕41号).

elections.label: First wage income of the year (STA 2020 No.13)
elections.description: The resident declared no wage income earlier this year: CNY5,000 is deducted for every month from January.

elections.label: CNY60,000 deducted from January (STA 2020 No.19)
elections.description: Qualifying continuing employee: declared by this employer every month of the prior year with that year’s wages at most CNY60,000.

name: IIT on an annual one-off bonus taxed separately (全年一次性奖金)
authority: MOF/STA 2023 No.30 (to 31 December 2027): a resident may have a qualifying annual one-off bonus taxed apart from the year’s wages: the bonus ÷ 12 selects the rate and quick deduction of the monthly comprehensive-income table, and the tax is bonus × rate − quick deduction. Once per person per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号). https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5211524/content.html. A bonus the employee does not elect to separate is an ordinary bonus class counted in IIT. Non-resident bonus treatment (MOF/STA 2019 No.35) is not transcribed and refuses.

rules.refusal: A separately taxed annual bonus is a resident election (MOF/STA 2023 No.30); the non-resident bonus rule (MOF/STA 2019 No.35) is not transcribed.
The separate annual-bonus method may be used once per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号); pay a second bonus as an ordinary bonus.

name: IIT on a lump sum on ending the labour relationship (解除劳动关系一次性补偿收入)
authority: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(1) (from 1 Jan 2019, http://szs.mof.gov.cn/zhengcefabu/201812/t20181227_3110164.htm): a lump sum a resident receives on ending the labour relationship (economic compensation, living subsidy and similar) is exempt up to three times the local prior-year average annual wage; the excess is not added to the year’s comprehensive income and is taxed alone on the annual comprehensive-income table (STA 2018 No.61 annex). The average is the exit fact lcl47_average_monthly_wage × 12, or unrecorded the version’s default for it; the same series and year as LCL art.47 (owner rule 2026-09-28, register CN-N39 / CN-SH50). A non-resident’s termination pay is not transcribed and refuses.

rules.refusal: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(1) is read for a resident; a non-resident’s termination pay is not transcribed.
